title: Comparative DFT investigation of 1T and 2H phase Janus TaSSe monolayers as potential sensors for toxic gas molecules
task: Gas-sensing performance of 1T and 2H phase Janus TaSSe monolayers
key_results: 1T phase thermodynamically more stable with stronger gas interactions; AsH₃ highest adsorption (Eads = −2.4 eV on 1T, −2.125 eV on 2H); recovery time at 500 K: 1.52×10⁶ s for AsH₃ on 1T (S-site), 2.63×10³ s on 2H (S-site)
comments: The adsorption mechanism is dominated by van der Waals physisorption rather than chemisorption, offering good recovery but potentially compromising selectivity; temperature-dependent recovery rates provide tunable gas sensing.

title: Time–temperature superposition of silicone rubber embedded with irregular-shaped magnetic particles under different magnetic fields
